items.title: Jean Bach interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well this morning we had Bill Crow. And in his book he tells this little story...

ctx.x: Yes. Well that was a heartbreak at first for him, because I think Norman Granz who was you know a genius about money, I think he thought that the small group would probably pay off better and they eliminated Freddie Green and Basie got apoplectic because that was his heartbeat. And so they finally rectified that.

Well this morning we had Bill Crow. And in his book he tells this little story about shortly after that small group went out that Freddie Green showed up at a gig and just set his stuff up and said “you’re not leaving me behind.”
